finding_freshness.interpretation: 旧 Finding 的被审核代码和测试已变化，因此旧证据正确判为 stale。没有将旧记录直接重新 stamp 为 current；解决结论由下面的新复现与行为验证支持。

original_reproduction.interpretation: 该脚本原本断言错误行为仍存在，因此修复后在 'refresh 应退出 1' 的旧断言处退出 1。真实 capture/refresh/confirm 子命令全部退出 0；这不是生产脚本故障。

commands.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements-dev.txt python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_refresh_context.py -v

commands.label: recheck-read-only-baseline
commands.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess
root=Path('<repository>')
folder=Path('<evaluation>/convergence-review')
files=['project-evolution-engine/scripts/refresh_context.py','tests/test_refresh_context.py','project-evolution-engine/scripts/change_evidence.py']
artifacts=['review.json','F-context-scope-001.json','scope-gap-evidence.json','reproduce_scope_gap.py']
state={
    'repository_files':{name:hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in files},
    'original_artifacts':{name:hashlib.sha256((folder/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in artifacts},
}
for label,args in [('git_head',['git','rev-parse','HEAD']),('git_status',['git','--no-optional-locks','status','--porcelain=v1','--untracked-files=no'])]:
    result=subprocess.run(args,cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True)
    state[label]={'exit_code':result.returncode,'stdout':result.stdout,'stderr':result.stderr}
print(json.dumps(state,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
PY

commands.label: recheck-git-scope
commands.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('<repository>')
for args in [['git','rev-parse','--show-toplevel'],['git','--no-optional-locks','ls-files','--','project-evolution-engine/scripts/refresh_context.py','tests/test_refresh_context.py','project-evolution-engine/scripts/change_evidence.py']]:
    result=subprocess.run(args,cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True)
    print(json.dumps({'command':args,'exit_code':result.returncode,'stdout':result.stdout,'stderr':result.stderr},ensure_ascii=False))
PY

commands.label: copy-original-reproduction-without-changing-it
commands.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,shutil
folder=Path('<evaluation>/convergence-review')
source=folder/'reproduce_scope_gap.py'
destination=folder/'recheck-original'/'reproduce_scope_gap.py'
destination.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
shutil.copyfile(source,destination)
assert source.read_bytes()==destination.read_bytes()
print(json.dumps({'copied_original_reproduction_to':str(destination),'unchanged_content_sha256':hashlib.sha256(destination.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},ensure_ascii=False))
PY

commands.label: recheck-final-source-and-original-artifact-preservation
commands.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json
root=Path('<repository>')
folder=Path('<evaluation>/convergence-review')
expected=json.loads("{\"repository_files\":{\"project-evolution-engine/scripts/refresh_context.py\":\"bc47ac29a4bf10312daeb0898e78cc7e30a09cdd76ec6bfcc52911f764fab2a4\",\"tests/test_refresh_context.py\":\"010a1498e4c506c211573c133d1782027655c82b488b5ca28b9cbf9f7c3fd65a\",\"project-evolution-engine/scripts/change_evidence.py\":\"b601879a57a09a3da8ea076e3c4d4df4b2219a5177da6e75df1e24eca721dc6f\"},\"original_artifacts\":{\"review.json\":\"05c29e11d4085770d41e44434d24044f74f6380fb4ae3b105fdf43f3d170dafc\",\"F-context-scope-001.json\":\"d2be38053f6b2d3d19b6c06320508011ed0ee8a6bf29b2de7f2e3415dbe0465a\",\"scope-gap-evidence.json\":\"3763e1f1b5aeb17bb04901cecf34b76bfe362a10e017eb1571460e4915eac64a\",\"reproduce_scope_gap.py\":\"8ff56d13276d6ee9b111ad9416f22ba232c9395603e015813220bd02f625c071\"},\"git_head\":{\"exit_code\":0,\"stdout\":\"6755a800e6c3c336c898c919b91f64c5d3749ff2\\n\",\"stderr\":\"\"},\"git_status\":{\"exit_code\":0,\"stdout\":\"\",\"stderr\":\"\"}}")

preservation.statement: 本次只读复核没有修改仓库源码、测试、配置或 Git 状态；原始 review.json、Finding、证据及复现脚本均按 SHA-256 验证未变。新文件仅写入同一专用临时目录。
preservation.git_observation: Git 根目录为目标仓库，但这两个新增审核文件未出现在 git ls-files 中，故空 git diff 不能证明它们的状态；本次使用逐文件 SHA-256 作为前后对比依据。
